title: layers block, schema 2: declarative layers (RESERVED for S8)
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §9 (K-R56). Only the outer shape and the ten fixed slots are settled; S8 designs types, sources, styles and legends and may tighten every property except id and slot. Menu order = array order. Absent block = the engine's built-in default layers.

source.description: Reserved: events | entities | items | nodes | routine | file:<path> | mvu:<path> (read only).

slot.description: One of the ten fixed viewport slots, bottom to top.

applies.description: Reserved: which nodes / node types / view kinds the layer applies to; elsewhere it is greyed out and paused.

style.description: Reserved: style parameters of the building block.

menu.description: Reserved: label, i18n, group and default visibility in the layer menu.
